text: A method in which one adolescent is studied in depth over a long period is called the:
explanation: A case study examines a single individual intensively.

text: Which statement about heredity and environment in development is most accurate?
options: Development results from the interaction of heredity and environment
explanation: Modern psychology holds that both interact throughout development.

text: An adolescent who starts thumb-sucking again after the birth of a sibling shows the defence mechanism of:
explanation: Regression is a return to behaviour typical of an earlier stage under stress.

text: The best way to help adolescents deal with negative peer pressure is to:
explanation: Assertiveness and self-confidence help adolescents resist harmful pressure.

text: The psychosocial crisis of adolescence according to Erikson is:
explanation: Adolescents search for who they are; failure leads to role confusion.

text: Conservation of number, mass and volume develops in Piaget's:
explanation: Conservation is a mark of concrete operational thinking (about 7 to 11 years).

text: Kohlberg's post-conventional level is guided by:
explanation: The highest stage rests on self-chosen universal principles of justice.

text: A child begins to walk at about a year mainly because of:
explanation: Maturation is growth that unfolds on a biological timetable.

text: The goal a person sets for himself in a future task is called his:
explanation: Level of aspiration is the standard a person sets for future performance.

text: According to Miller, the capacity of short-term memory is about:
explanation: Miller's "magical number seven, plus or minus two".

text: Which technique is widely used to generate many creative ideas in a group?
explanation: Brainstorming, introduced by Osborn, encourages many ideas without criticism.

text: Creative children are generally characterised by:
explanation: Curiosity, independence and openness to experience are common traits of creative learners.

text: Thorndike's law of effect states that behaviour followed by a satisfying result is:
explanation: Satisfying consequences stamp in the connection between stimulus and response.

text: Kohler's experiments with chimpanzees support which view of learning?
explanation: Sudden solution of a problem by seeing relationships is insight learning (Gestalt).

text: Ausubel's advance organiser is meant to:
options: Link new material to what the learner already knows
explanation: An advance organiser gives a framework before new content so it can be anchored.

text: Dyslexia is a learning disability that mainly affects:
explanation: Dyslexia is difficulty in reading and decoding words.

text: Adjusting teaching methods and tasks to suit the different needs of learners in one class is known as:
explanation: Differentiated instruction is a core practice of inclusive classrooms.

text: An experienced teacher who guides a younger colleague's professional growth acts as a:
explanation: A mentor offers guidance and support based on experience.

text: Teaching is described as a tripolar process involving:
explanation: The three poles are the teacher, the learner and the curriculum.

text: Calling the teacher a "social engineer" means the teacher:
options: Prepares pupils to contribute to social change
explanation: The teacher shapes values and skills that help build a better society.

text: In co-operative learning, students:
options: Work in small groups towards a shared goal
explanation: Members help one another and share responsibility for the group result.

text: A rubric is mainly used to:
options: Score performance against clearly defined criteria
explanation: A rubric lists criteria and performance levels for fair scoring.

text: Portfolio assessment is based on:
options: A collection of a student's work over time
explanation: A portfolio shows growth by collecting work across a period.

text: Positive feedback in the classroom mainly helps to:
options: Build confidence and encourage the desired behaviour
explanation: Specific positive feedback reinforces effort and behaviour.

text: Professional ethics requires a teacher to:
explanation: Confidentiality and fairness are basic duties of a teacher.

text: Under the RTE Act 2009, no child can be held back or expelled until the completion of:
explanation: The Act's no-detention provision applies up to the end of elementary education.

text: Which of the following is a guiding principle of NCF 2005?
options: Making examinations the centre of schooling
Connecting knowledge to life outside the school
explanation: NCF 2005 asks that knowledge be linked to the learner's life beyond the school.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ഓണം കേരളത്തിന്റെ ദേശീയോത്സവമാണ്. ചിങ്ങമാസത്തിലാണ് ഇത് ആഘോഷിക്കുന്നത്. പൂക്കളമിടലും ഓണസദ്യയും ഓണക്കളികളും ഇതിന്റെ പ്രത്യേകതകളാണ്. ജാതിമതഭേദമില്ലാതെ എല്ലാവരും ഇതിൽ പങ്കുചേരുന്നു.” ഓണത്തിന്റെ എടുത്തുപറയാവുന്ന സവിശേഷത എന്താണ്?
explanation: അവസാനവാക്യത്തിൽ ജാതിമതഭേദമില്ലാതെ എല്ലാവരും പങ്കെടുക്കുന്നു എന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “ശുചിത്വം ആരോഗ്യത്തിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനമാണ്. വ്യക്തിശുചിത്വത്തിനൊപ്പം പരിസരശുചിത്വവും പാലിച്ചാൽ രോഗങ്ങളെ വലിയൊരളവിൽ തടയാൻ കഴിയും.” ‘അടിസ്ഥാനം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന് ഏറ്റവും അടുത്ത അർഥമുള്ള പദം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘അടിസ്ഥാനം’ എന്നാൽ അടിത്തറ, ആധാരം എന്നൊക്കെയാണ് അർഥം.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “വേനൽക്കാലത്ത് ഉറുമ്പ് കഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട് ധാന്യം ശേഖരിച്ചു. ചീവീടാകട്ടെ പാട്ടുപാടി നടന്നു. മഴക്കാലമായപ്പോൾ ചീവീടിന് ഭക്ഷണമില്ലാതെ വിഷമിക്കേണ്ടി വന്നു.” ഈ കഥയിൽ നിന്ന് ലഭിക്കുന്ന പാഠം എന്താണ്?
explanation: മുൻകരുതലോടെ പ്രവർത്തിച്ച ഉറുമ്പ് രക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു, അല്ലാത്ത ചീവീട് വിഷമിച്ചു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “കുന്നിൻചെരിവിൽ കുളിരുംകാറ്റിൽ കുഞ്ഞിളം പൂക്കൾ ചിരിക്കുന്നു; പുഴയൊരു പാട്ടിൻ ശ്രുതിയും ചേർത്ത് പുഞ്ചിരിതൂകിയൊഴുകുന്നു.” ഈ വരികളിൽ പ്രധാനമായി വർണിക്കുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
explanation: കുന്ന്, കാറ്റ്, പൂക്കൾ, പുഴ എന്നിവയുടെ ഭംഗിയാണ് വർണിക്കുന്നത്.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “കുന്നിൻചെരിവിൽ കുളിരുംകാറ്റിൽ കുഞ്ഞിളം പൂക്കൾ ചിരിക്കുന്നു.” ഇവിടെ ‘ചിരിക്കുന്നു’ എന്ന പ്രയോഗം ആരെക്കുറിച്ചാണ്?
explanation: ‘കുഞ്ഞിളം പൂക്കൾ ചിരിക്കുന്നു’ എന്നാണ് വരി; പൂക്കളിൽ മനുഷ്യന്റെ ചിരി ആരോപിക്കുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “കാലം കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ തിരികെ വരില്ല, കർമം ചെയ്യുക സമയത്തിൽ.” ഈ വരികൾ നൽകുന്ന സന്ദേശം എന്താണ്?
explanation: പോയ കാലം തിരികെ വരില്ല, അതിനാൽ കർമം സമയത്ത് ചെയ്യണമെന്നാണ് സന്ദേശം.

text: ‘ആകാശം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ പര്യായമല്ലാത്തത് ഏത്?
explanation: വാനം, നഭസ്സ്, അംബരം എന്നിവ ആകാശത്തിന്റെ പര്യായങ്ങളാണ്; ഭൂമി വേറെയാണ്.

text: ‘സത്യം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതപദം ഏത്?
explanation: സത്യത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതം അസത്യമാണ്.

text: ‘വിദ്യ അഭ്യസിക്കുന്നവൻ’ എന്നതിന് ഒറ്റപ്പദം ഏത്?
explanation: വിദ്യ അഭ്യസിക്കുന്നവൻ വിദ്യാർഥിയാണ്.

text: ‘പോകുക’ എന്ന ക്രിയയുടെ ഭൂതകാലരൂപം ഏത്?
explanation: ഭൂതകാലത്തിൽ ‘പോയി’ എന്ന രൂപം വരുന്നു.

text: ‘നീ എവിടെ പോകുന്നു?’ എന്ന വാക്യം ഏത് തരത്തിൽപ്പെടുന്നു?
explanation: ചോദ്യം ചോദിക്കുന്ന വാക്യമായതിനാൽ പ്രശ്നാർഥമാണ്.

text: ‘കുട്ടി’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ ബഹുവചനം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘-കൾ’ പ്രത്യയം ചേർത്ത് ബഹുവചനം ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു.

text: ശരിയായ വാക്യം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘ഇന്നലെ’ എന്ന ഭൂതകാല സൂചകത്തോടൊപ്പം ‘വന്നില്ല’ എന്ന ഭൂതകാല നിഷേധരൂപമാണ് ചേരുക.

text: ‘നെൽ + മണി = നെന്മണി’ ഏത് സന്ധിക്ക് ഉദാഹരണം?
explanation: ‘ൽ’ എന്ന വർണത്തിന് പകരം ‘ൻ’ വരുന്നതിനാൽ ആദേശസന്ധിയാണ്.

text: ‘അമ്മയോട്’ എന്ന പദം ഏത് വിഭക്തിയിൽപ്പെടുന്നു?
explanation: ‘-ഓട്’ പ്രത്യയം സംയോജിക വിഭക്തിയുടേതാണ്.

text: ‘കൈമലർത്തുക’ എന്ന ശൈലിയുടെ അർഥം ഏത്?
explanation: കൈ മലർത്തുക എന്നാൽ നിസ്സഹായത കാണിച്ച് ഒഴിഞ്ഞുമാറുക എന്നാണ്.

text: ‘അടിമേൽ അടിച്ചാൽ അമ്മിയും നീങ്ങും’ എന്ന പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലിന്റെ ആശയം ഏത്?
options: നിരന്തര പരിശ്രമം കൊണ്ട് ഏത് കാര്യവും സാധിക്കും
explanation: തുടർച്ചയായ പരിശ്രമം കൊണ്ട് വലിയ തടസ്സങ്ങളും മറികടക്കാം.

text: ‘വീണപൂവ്’ എന്ന കാവ്യം രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: വീണപൂവ് കുമാരനാശാന്റെ കൃതിയാണ്.

text: ‘നീലാകാശം’ എന്ന പദം ഏത് സമാസത്തിൽപ്പെടുന്നു?
explanation: ‘നീലമായ ആകാശം’ എന്ന് വിശേഷണ-വിശേഷ്യ ബന്ധമായതിനാൽ കർമധാരയനാണ്.

text: ‘ഉമാകേരളം’ എന്ന മഹാകാവ്യത്തിന്റെ കർത്താവ് ആരാണ്?
explanation: ഉമാകേരളം രചിച്ചത് ഉള്ളൂർ എസ്. പരമേശ്വരയ്യരാണ്.

text: A wave has a frequency of 50 Hz and a wavelength of 4 m. Its speed is:
explanation: v = f x wavelength = 50 x 4 = 200 m/s.

text: SONAR is a device that uses:
explanation: SONAR measures depth and locates objects using reflected ultrasonic waves.

text: The defect of vision myopia is corrected using a:
explanation: A myopic eye focuses distant objects in front of the retina; a diverging concave lens corrects this.

text: The power of a convex lens of focal length 20 cm is:
explanation: P = 1/f (in metres) = 1/0.2 = 5 D.

text: A body weighs 10 N in air. When fully immersed in water the buoyant force on it is 6 N. Its apparent weight in water is:
explanation: Apparent weight = weight - buoyant force = 10 - 6 = 4 N.

text: Which mode of heat transfer does not need a material medium?
explanation: Heat from the Sun reaches the Earth through space by radiation.

text: A ball is thrown vertically upward with a speed of 20 m/s (g = 10 m/s²). The maximum height reached is:
explanation: v² = 2gh gives h = 400/20 = 20 m.

text: In uniform circular motion the centripetal force acts:
explanation: Centripetal force always points towards the centre of the circle.

text: The escape velocity from the surface of the Earth is about:
explanation: Escape velocity from the Earth is about 11.2 km/s.

text: A machine does 600 J of work in 20 s. Its power is:
explanation: Power = work / time = 600 / 20 = 30 W.

text: A potential difference of 12 V is applied across a 6 Ω resistor. The current is:
An ammeter is connected in a circuit:
explanation: An ammeter has very low resistance and must be in series.

text: A lightning conductor protects a building because it:
options: Attracts the lightning to the building
Safely conducts the charge to the earth through pointed ends
explanation: Pointed metal rods discharge the cloud's charge and carry it safely to the ground.

text: According to Faraday's law of electrolysis, the mass of a substance deposited is directly proportional to the:
explanation: m is proportional to the charge Q = It.

text: An electric motor works on the principle that a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field:
explanation: The force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field turns the motor's coil.

text: A Zener diode is mainly used as a:
explanation: A Zener diode in reverse breakdown holds the voltage constant.

text: A transistor can be used as:
explanation: Transistors amplify signals and switch currents on and off.

text: When water is electrolysed, the volumes of hydrogen and oxygen produced are in the ratio:
explanation: 2H₂O gives 2H₂ + O₂, so hydrogen is twice the volume of oxygen.

text: In Bohr's model of the atom, electrons:
options: Are embedded in a positive sphere
Move in fixed circular orbits without radiating energy
explanation: Bohr proposed stable orbits of fixed energy.

text: Atoms of the same element with different mass numbers are called:
explanation: Isotopes have the same atomic number but different numbers of neutrons.

text: Aluminium is extracted from bauxite by:
options: Reduction with carbon in a blast furnace
Electrolysis of molten alumina dissolved in cryolite
explanation: Aluminium is too reactive for carbon reduction, so electrolysis is used.

text: Brass is an alloy of:
explanation: Brass = copper + zinc; bronze = copper + tin.

text: A solution that cannot dissolve any more solute at a given temperature is called:
explanation: A saturated solution holds the maximum solute possible at that temperature.

text: Chromatography is used to separate:
options: Components of a mixture of dyes or pigments
explanation: Different components move at different rates on the stationary phase.

text: Mendeleev arranged elements in his periodic table in the increasing order of their:
explanation: Mendeleev's law was based on atomic mass; the modern law uses atomic number.

text: Group 17 elements are known as:
explanation: Fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine are halogens.

text: Which molecule contains a triple covalent bond?
explanation: Two nitrogen atoms share three pairs of electrons.

text: Which gas is called the fuel of the future?
explanation: Hydrogen burns to give only water and a lot of energy.

text: Laughing gas is:
explanation: Nitrous oxide (N₂O) is the laughing gas.

text: The ability of carbon atoms to link with each other to form long chains is called:
explanation: Catenation explains the huge number of carbon compounds.

text: Hydrochloric acid reacts with sodium hydroxide to form:
explanation: Neutralisation: acid + base gives salt + water.

text: 300 mL of a gas at 300 K is heated to 600 K at constant pressure. Its new volume is:
explanation: Charles's law: V1/T1 = V2/T2, so V2 = 300 x 600 / 300 = 600 mL.

text: The number of molecules in one mole of a substance is:
explanation: This is Avogadro's number.

text: C. V. Raman received the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on the:
explanation: The Raman effect concerns the scattering of light.

text: Which of the following is an objective in the affective domain?
options: Calculates the speed of a car
explanation: Appreciation, interest and attitudes belong to the affective domain.

text: Which of these is a component of scientific attitude?
explanation: Open-mindedness, curiosity and respect for evidence mark a scientific attitude.

text: The disciplinary value of science teaching refers to:
options: Training of the mind in reasoning and problem solving
explanation: Science trains the mind in observation, reasoning and problem solving.

text: Piaget's term for fitting new experiences into existing schemes is:
explanation: Assimilation fits new information into existing schemas; accommodation changes the schemas.

text: Gagne's hierarchy of learning begins with:
explanation: Gagne's hierarchy runs from signal learning up to problem solving.

text: A unit plan is:
options: A plan for one period only
A plan for teaching a whole unit or topic as an organised whole
explanation: A unit plan organises the teaching of a complete topic over several periods.

text: Good instructional objectives in a lesson plan should be:
explanation: Specific, measurable objectives make evaluation possible.

text: The advance organiser model of teaching is associated with:
explanation: Ausubel's model presents an organiser to link new content with prior knowledge.

text: In the inquiry training model, the teacher answers the students' questions only with:
explanation: Suchman's model uses yes/no questions so students must frame their own hypotheses.

text: The demonstration method is most suitable when:
options: Equipment is costly or experiments are dangerous
Each student has a full laboratory
explanation: The teacher can show costly or hazardous experiments safely.

text: In the lecture-cum-demonstration method the teacher:
options: Explains while performing experiments before the class
explanation: It combines explanation with experimental demonstration.

text: Which of the following is a step in the problem-solving method?
options: Defining the problem and collecting data
explanation: Defining the problem, collecting data, forming and testing hypotheses are its steps.

text: The environmental approach to science teaching emphasises learning from:
explanation: It uses the learner's surroundings as a resource for science learning.

text: Correlation in the science curriculum means:
options: Linking topics of physics with chemistry and other subjects
explanation: Correlation relates content across and within subjects.

text: Which is a feature of a good science textbook?
options: Accurate content with activities and illustrations
explanation: A good textbook is accurate, graded and activity-based.

text: A science fair is organised mainly to:
options: Show projects and encourage scientific creativity
explanation: Fairs let students display projects and develop interest in science.

text: Before constructing an achievement test, the first step is usually to prepare the:
explanation: A blueprint plans the weightage of content, objectives and question types.

text: Remedial teaching is given after:
explanation: Remedial teaching responds to difficulties found by diagnosis.

text: Which of the following supports the professional development of teachers?
explanation: Continuous training, workshops and reflection improve teaching.
